entities.name: Olga Núñez Abaunza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olga Núñez Abaunza was the first female Nicaraguan lawyer and first female notary. She was the first woman to serve in a Ministerial capacity and the first woman Deputy to serve in the National Assembly of Nicaragua. She was an ardent feminist, attending feminist conferences, forming a feminine wing of the liberal party, and running for office on a feminist platform.
